scope: Independent read-only original-instruction review of conditional general-converter order, packed24 intermediate quantization and unity decode. Candidate source review; author/fidelity numeric controls inspected but not rerun.

custody_checks.method: Independent Python Mach-O LC_SEGMENT_64 address-to-file translation; original image SHA pinned; full slice/readback equality and every listed native word rechecked. No sealer rerun or sealed-file mutation.

claim_reviews.result: Agrees within finite stable format/rate values. The general converter computes a rate-difference flag, enters early source-format conversion if source rate is greater, or if destination bits are24 and source bits are not24. Remaining type, channel and gain stages precede the later below-rate branch. Source byte-order/layout normalization can occur before these stages, so this is not a claim that rate conversion is the first instruction or all-format transform.

Agrees. w4=1 selects source bits/channels/kind in100326318; bits24 index2 reaches10032646c via table103934638. Unity packed24 decode precedes10030a534; returned frame count times source channels controls the packed24 output loop.

Agrees. Float32×2^23 is separately rounded; compare>=8388607 selects upper endpoint, compare<−8388608 selects lower endpoint. Interior FCVTZS integer then binary64 residual uses absolute0.5 and odd parity for ties-even adjustment. Integer zero discards signed zero before subsequent decode. Candidate preflight protects integer conversion and preserves whole buffer on rejected inputs.

Agrees with conditional source kind1/bits24, destination kind2/bits32 and unity gain. Original index2/index3 cells lead through source-kind check and destination-kind check to capability-selected LE decoders. Scalar paths produce exact signed24/2^23: one directly converts signed24 then scales2^-23; the other left-aligns by8 then scales2^-31. This review does not newly rederive every SIMD shuffle; prior PCM24 finding retains that separate proof.

Agrees. Candidate is a defensive in-place numerical stage, not a complete resampler, format selector or current native backend identity. It must remain gated by actual source-format and composition prerequisites.

validation_review.candidate_source_review: No actionable mismatch found in admitted finite normal-or-zero, nearest/ties-even arm64 domain. Scaling, saturation, parity, signed correction and exact integer/power-of-two decode match original sequence.
validation_review.independent_numeric_controls: 681 vectors,606 accepted/75 rejected and optimized/UBSan results retained in author validation; inspected as supporting evidence, not reported as a new run by this reviewer.
validation_review.broader_limits: Buffer capacity/lifetime and concurrent mutation remain caller obligations; rate backend/state/count, active registry/file parser, nonunity gain and channel remapping are not established here.

publication_boundary: Compact review pins private local native artifacts; this does not authorize or imply publication of proprietary image, native slices or REA dumps.
application_acceptance: APP016 development milestone only. No new GUI release, whole-project playback or Cubase runtime/PCM comparison is asserted.
